entities.name: Sevgil Musayeva-Borovyk

entities.summary: Sevgi Khairetdynivna Musayeva is a Ukrainian journalist from Crimea, Ukraine, chief-editor of internet publishing Ukrainska Pravda and an initiator of creating the KrymSOS web portal.
